name: Maxun pending → active + enriched jobs insert

nodes.name: Filter junk rows
nodes.notes: Belt-and-suspenders defensive filter — server already filters at insert time, but this catches legacy migrated rows and any edge cases. Drops cookie banners ("Learn more about this provider"), pagination ("Last page", "Next »"), and non-job URLs (privacy/cookie/legal/terms/safety paths and subdomains).

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: Batch size 4. Output 0 = done (after loop), Output 1 = loop body.

nodes.name: Delay 500ms
nodes.notes: 500ms pause between scrape.do calls to avoid rate limiting.

nodes.name: scrape.do
nodes.notes: Retries 3x with 5s backoff. On final failure, continues with empty data so the job still gets inserted with canonical fields.

nodes.name: Parse scraped job details
nodes.notes: Extracts jobTitle, companyName, jobDescription, and apply_url from the scrape.do HTML response. Priority: JSON-LD JobPosting > OG meta tags > <title>/<h1> > hostname. On failure emits nulls so Maxun data is used as fallback.

options.systemMessage:
You extract structured job fields for a database from the job posting markdown.

Return ONLY one JSON object (no markdown code fences, no text before or after). All keys are required. Example shape:
{"jobTitle":"Senior Software Engineer","companyName":"Google","requirements":"...","location":"Seattle, WA","salaryAnnualUSD":150000,"minYearsExperience":5}

Field rules:
- jobTitle: The official role title as shown on the posting (concise). Never use generic page chrome alone.
- companyName: The **real hiring employer** brand or legal name (e.g. Google, Amazon, JPMorgan Chase). Never return generic portal labels alone such as: Careers, Jobs, Hiring, Job Board, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Taleo, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, Jobvite — unless that token is literally the employer name in context. Prefer the organization named in the posting body, header, or byline; use the listing URL host only as a weak hint.
- requirements: Verbatim Requirements / Responsibilities / Qualifications section only. If none, use empty string.
- location: City and state/region when possible (e.g. "Austin, TX" or "Remote, US"). Empty string if unknown.
- salaryAnnualUSD: Integer annual base salary in USD. If a range, use midpoint rounded. If hourly only, multiply by ~2080 for full-time year. Use 0 if unknown.
- minYearsExperience: Integer minimum years of experience explicitly required (e.g. "5+ years" -> 5). Use 0 if unknown.

nodes.name: Extract Requirements
nodes.notes: Retries once on transient LLM errors (rate limits). On final failure, emits empty so jobDescription falls back to canonical data.

nodes.name: Accumulate Result
nodes.notes: Stores each enriched job in workflow static data. After loop completes, all are bulk-retrieved.

nodes.name: Get All Processed Jobs
nodes.notes: Fires after loop completes (done output). Returns all accumulated enriched jobs for bulk insert.

parameters.content:
## Maxun → enriched jobs

1. Attach **MongoDB** credential (`firststep_db`).
2. Attach **Google Gemini (PaLM)** credential.
3. **Prepare** → set `CREATED_BY`. Passes **sectorIndustry**, **f500**, **location**, **salary**, **jobExperience**.
4. **Filter junk rows** → **scrape.do** → **Parse scraped job details** (structured hints + JSON-LD).
5. **Gemini** reads **full-page markdown** + parser/Maxun hints; returns JSON including **jobTitle** and **companyName** (real employer — rejects generic "Careers"/ATS names), plus requirements, location, salary, experience.
6. **Assemble** prefers LLM title/company when good, else parser, else Maxun; **sectorIndustry** / **f500** from Maxun only.
7. **Insert into jobs**.
